models.homophonic: Several symbols may stand for the same letter (Zodiac's usual method)
models.zodiac: Homophonic, but each letter gets no more symbols than Zodiac gave it in Z408/Z340

families.decimations: Read every k-th symbol, wrapping around
families.routes: Boustrophedon and column-by-column reads for each grid width
families.griddec: Z340-style diagonal reads on a grid (how Z340 was transposed)
families.columnar2to6: Keyed columnar transposition, widths 2-6, every key (872 orders)
families.columnar7to8_sampled: Keyed columnar transposition, widths 7-8, 500 random keys each

letters.label: Letter patterns
letters.help: 5-letter chunks; passes every calibration. Best for Z13.

words.label: Whole words
words.help: Decodes must split into real English words. Best detector for Z32 (power ~0.2-0.28 vs ~0.07); English only.
